mentions.name: Three Black and Milds
mentions.description: A written piece titled "Three Black and Milds" depicting a night in Juarez, with no commentary or lesson, portraying the city, its people, and what it sells and what is bought. The author is also beginning an MFA at LSU New Orleans next fall.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My latest piece, Three Black and Milds, a night in Juarez. No commentary, no lesson, just the city and the people in it, what it sells and what is bought.

https://www.metanoia-research.com/dispatch-007-three-black-and-milds/
